answer_1.quote: We consider a seq2seq translation from the sign language tokens to the text tokens... As a final downstream application, we train a phrase-conditional LLM on discrete sign representations, identical to MusicGen. The model accepts four sequences of integers from a quantizer together with the phrases to be signed and generates four parallel sequences of tokens.
answer_1.outputs: Generated discrete sign token sequences and corresponding text characters (machine‑translated captions).
